claims: Emma Stone has won two Academy Awards for Best Actress.
Emma Stone won her first Oscar for her role as Mia in La La Land (2016), according to Britannica and People.com.
Emma Stone won her second Oscar for portraying Bella Baxter in Poor Things (2023), according to Britannica and People.com.
Emma Stone won Best Actress for La La Land (2017).
Emma Stone won Best Actress for Poor Things (2024).
As of the 2026 Oscars, Emma Stone has earned five acting nominations.
Emma Stone earned an acting nomination for Birdman.
Emma Stone earned an acting nomination for The Favourite.
Emma Stone earned an acting nomination for Bugonia.
Emma Stone received a Best Picture nomination for producing Poor Things.
Emma Stone received a Best Picture nomination for producing Bugonia.
With her 2026 nomination for Bugonia, Emma Stone became the youngest woman to earn seven total Oscar nominations (including acting and producing).
